variable {M N X : Type*} [Monoid M] [Monoid N] [MulAction M X] [MulAction N X] {K L : ℝ}

the action by the monoid `M`."]

  rintro ⟨F, hF, -⟩; exact (#F).cast_nonneg.trans hF

  rintro ⟨F, hF, hFAB⟩; exact ⟨F, hF.trans hKL, hFAB⟩
